U.note: Simple, complete two-color ASCII mixer with ratio bar, linear/sRGB models, keyboard shortcuts and validation; only the gradient bar overflows on mobile.

V.note: Pigment pots plus three mixing models feeding a painted ASCII grid; seeded demo shows mixing at once, responsive, but grander than 'simple'.

W.note: Bowl-and-brush painter opens on an empty dotted canvas with only a one-line ASCII bowl, and on mobile the controls are clipped off the right edge.

X.note: Animated ASCII bowl that ripples to each mixed color is charming and simple, but starts empty and the Black pigment label is nearly invisible.

Y.note: Full paint program with many controls and a bolted-on two-color mixer, which overshoots 'simple' and splits focus, though painting and mixing work.

Z.note: Two-color ratio mixer with command prompt, history and arrow keys works well, but the dither glyph field looks noisy and the placeholder prompt is cut off on mobile.
